Next slide please.

In the eastbound direction 22nd Street West currently has two travel lanes that widen into a third travel lane between deep and Baker Drive and Fairmont Drive.

Extending the third travel lane to deep and Baker Drive and installing Kurban gutter on the south side of the road will align with the future state recommended in the Circle Drive West functional planning study.
Next slide please.
The pedestrian and drainage infrastructure in the south west corner of the 22nd Street West and Confederation Drive intersection currently interfere with each other.
